Did I just waste 2-years of my life? 

These past two years were nothing like I expected. In this video, I’m sharing what my mission was really like, the good, the hard, and everything in between.

It started with submitting my papers, getting my call, and feeling totally overwhelmed. I had anxiety for the first time in my life, and saying goodbye to my family and girlfriend was way harder than I thought it’d be. Then I was off to Brazil, still in shock, trying to process everything, and stepping into a completely different world.

I started to adjust, and then out of nowhere, I had to get emergency gallbladder surgery and fly back home. That completely threw me off. I didn’t know if I was supposed to go back or if that was it. A while later, I got reassigned to Boston, packed up again, and said goodbye for the second time.

Boston was a whole different experience. In the video, I talk about what my daily life looked like, the people I met, the crazy moments, and the miracles I got to see. I made some of my closest friends, learned how to serve in ways I didn’t expect, and had a lot of time to reflect.

Coming home now, it’s been weird looking back at it all. There were a lot of ups and downs. Moments where I didn’t feel like I was enough, and others where things just clicked.
